Hello from Southwest Engineers of Louisiana,

Welcome to this edition of our newsletter. As temperatures climb across the region, we want to share a few thoughts on keeping your industrial cooling and closed-loop recirculating systems running smoothly.

First, our molybdate based multi duty industrial coolant treatment remains a favorite among facilities teams who need dependable protection for their equipment. Regular testing and consistent dosing go a long way toward preventing costly downtime.

Second, our corrosion inhibitor for closed recirculating systems continues to help customers protect piping, pumps and heat exchangers from long-term damage. We recommend scheduling a water analysis each season so small issues are caught early.

Finally, our technical team is available for site visits and training sessions throughout the year. Reach out any time to learn how we can support your maintenance program.

Warm regards,

The Southwest Engineers of Louisiana Team
